content.short: Multi-currency accounts, exchange, treasury, spend management and transfers.
content.description: Juicyway is a Nigerian stablecoin-powered payments platform that helps African businesses and individuals send, receive, and hold foreign currency across borders. Having quietly processed more than a billion dollars in cross-border volume, it offers multi-currency accounts, currency exchange at market-driven rates, treasury and spend-management tools, and fast international transfers in currencies like NGN, USD, GBP, and CAD. Under the hood, Juicyway settles using USDT and USDC over networks such as Ethereum and Tron, partnering with stablecoin infrastructure like Bridge and banks including Access Bank and Lead Bank to bridge crypto liquidity with local and US accounts. It targets creators, freelancers, and companies that need reliable global money movement without slow, costly bank wires.
content.meta: Juicyway offers stablecoin-powered multi-currency accounts and cross-border transfers in Africa. Discover Juicyway and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
